paite: Tuin samin; nang hondawng kuamahmah a om a? huan misiangthoute lakah a kua pen lam na nga dia?
english: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

paite: Lungjinnain lah mi hai a that ngala, huan thiknain mi mawl a hihlum sek hi.
english: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

paite: Mihai zungkai ka mutaa; himahleh thakhatin a tenna ka hamsiat hi.
english: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

paite: A tate bitna akipan gamla pi ah a om ua, huan kongpi ah hihgawpin a om uh, kuamah amaute suakta ding a om sam kei uhi.
english: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

paite: Kua anlak ding ahia gilkialmiin a gaih khita, ling laka kipan nasana a lak khiak, thangin a sum uh duhin a kam lianpiin a ka hi.
english: whose harvest the hungry eats up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

paite: Gimthuakna lah leivui akipanin a hongpawt keia, lei a kipanin buaina leng a hongdawn khe sam kei hi;
english: For affliction doesn’t come forth from the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

paite: Himahleh mihing buai ding maha piang ahi, meiekte a tou len bangin.
english: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

paite: Himahleh ken ahihleh, Pathian lamah ka zong dinga, huan Pathian kiangah ka thu ka koih ding hi.
english: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

paite: Thil thupite hihpa leh zonkhiaktheihlouh; sim zohlouh thil lamdangte:
english: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

paite: Lei tunga vuah pepa leh, loute tunga tui sawlpa:
english: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

paite: Huchiin aman a niamsate tung sangah a koihtou a; huan misi sunte muanna ah a tawisang hi.
english: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

paite: Zekhemhatte lunggelte bangmahlou a suaksaka, huchiin a khutte un a thiltup uh a hih theikei uhi.
english: He frustrates the devices of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

paite: Mi pilte a zekhemhatna un a mana: huan mihoihloute thugen akhupathalin a paihsak hi.
english: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

paite: Sunlaiin khomialna a thuak ua, janlai bangin suntang laiin a mai maimah uh.
english: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

paite: Himahleh a kam ua kipanin pabeite ahondama, mi hatte khut akipanin tasamte mahmah.
english: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

paite: Huchiin gentheiin lametna a neia, huan, thulimlouhnain a kam a humsak hi.
english: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

paite: Ngaiin, Pathianin a bawlhoih min nuam a sa hi; huaijiakin Bangkim hihthei sawina musit ken.
english: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

paite: Aman lah meima a bawla, a tuama: a liamsaka, huan a khutin a damsak hi.
english: For he wounds, and binds up. He injures, and his hands make whole.

paite: Buaina gukah a honsuakta sak dinga; ahi, sagih ah gilouin nang a honkhoih kei ding hi.
english: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil shall touch you.

paite: Kial chiangin nang sihna akipan a hontan ding; namsau thilhihtheihna akipan, kidou chiangin.
english: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

paite: Lei jepna akipanin selin na om dinga; siatna ahongtun chiangin na lau sam kei ding hi.
english: You shall be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither shall you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

paite: Siatna leh kialna ah na nui dinga, lei gamsate na kihta sam kei ding hi.
english: At destruction and famine you shall laugh, neither shall you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

paite: Gama suangte toh na kithuahtheih ding jiak un; huan gama gamsate nang tohna kituak ding uhi.
english: For you shall be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field shall be at peace with you.

paite: Huan na puanin muangin a om chih na thei ding; huan na ganhuang na veh dinga, bangmah kimlou a om kei ding hi.
english: You shall know that your tent is in peace. You shall visit your fold, and shall miss nothing.

paite: Na chite leng a thupi ding chih na thei dinga, huan na suante lei loupa bangin.
english: You shall know also that your seed shall be great, Your offspring as the grass of the earth.

paite: Kum chingin na han na juan dinga, a huna buh lak bangin.Ngaiin, hiai, i zongta ua, huchiin a om, jain, na hoihna dingin theiin.
english: You shall come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

paite: Ngaiin, hiai, i zongta ua, huchiin a om, jain, na hoihna dingin theiin.
english: Look this, we have searched it, so it is. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
